run_animal_handler: run the animal_handler function on a dataset path to extract metadata and image generators from zip files
review_animal_handler: review the animal_handler function that processes zip archives and returns dataset metadata with split generators
summarize_animal_dataset: summarize the animal_dataset DownloadableDataset configuration with download URLs and handler for non-rigid shape data
test_path_to_label_fn: test the _path_to_label_fn helper that extracts a label from a nested file path and maps it to an integer ID
refactor_animal_handler: refactor the animal_handler to support configurable image channels or dynamic image shape detection from zip contents
